conviction_note: FY2026 is mostly known (9M adj. EBIT ex-inventory already tracking about +6.4% against a mid-single-digit guide), so the move rests on the FY2027 first guide and the dividend commitment, which I can't call. Three things tilt p_up slightly above 50: the single sourced broker bar (Renta 4) implies a flat Q4, the stock rose on each of its last five results days, and the Italian excise hikes fall inside FY27. Against that, the stock trades above every sourced price target. The findings sum (+0.4) and the scaled number (+0.35) agree in sign and size.

new_in_release.expect: FY2027 first guide. The likely form is a repeat of 'mid-single-digit adj. EBIT growth ex-POI' (Renta 4 models +4.4%). The Italian excise steps in Jan and Jul 2027 support reported (incl. POI) EBIT. Direction: unknown, slight upside.

FY26 final dividend: at least EUR1.51 to reach the EUR2.09 floor after the EUR0.58 interim. The 2024-2026 floor expires, so the board has to say whether it carries into FY27. Payout is already about 99%. Likely maintained; a cut is a low-probability, large negative.
Q4 adj. EBIT ex-POI. Renta 4's FY figure implies Q4 roughly flat (about EUR91m vs about EUR90.6m) after 9M growth of about +6.4%. Slight beat expected.
unknown; tobacco excise float and working capital swing at year end

findings.finding: From the company's own releases, 9M FY26 adj. EBIT ex-stock-appreciation was about EUR258m against about EUR242m (+6.4%), up from a 'mid-single-digit' H1. Renta 4's FY ex-POI estimate of EUR349m implies Q4 roughly flat year on year, so continued run-rate growth would put FY ex-POI near EUR352-354m, about 1-1.5% above that bar.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q3 FY26 (Jul 24 2026), when the 9M growth turned positive: +2.46% close-to-close (IBEX +1.65%). H1 FY26 (Apr 30 2026), adj. EBIT -3.5% but ex-POI in line: +1.40%. Yahoo tape https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/LOG.MC?range=3y&interval=1d
findings.why_not_priced: The bar is one broker's preview that calls the print a non-event ('sin sorpresas'). If the Q4 run-rate were priced, previews would carry FY ex-POI near +6%, not +4.8%. Sized toward 0 because the figure sits inside the company's mid-single-digit guide, and capped because the bar has a single source.

findings.finding: Italy's 2027 budget moves the next tobacco excise rise forward: two steps, 1 January 2027 (EUR35.50 per 1,000 cigarettes) and 1 July 2027 (EUR38.50). Both fall inside Logista's FY27 (Oct 2026-Sep 2027) and should generate Italian stock-appreciation gains that support reported adj. EBIT and the tone of the FY27 outlook.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: FY25 results (Nov 6 2025), first FY26 guide: +2.71% close-to-close. FY24 results (Nov 6 2024): +2.20% against IBEX -2.90%. Neither is attributable to a specific POI comment.
findings.original_quote: Il governo ha deciso di anticipare di sei mesi l'aumento delle accise sul tabacco, che era previsto dal 2028. (Italian: the government decided to bring forward by six months the tobacco excise increase that had been scheduled for 2028.)
findings.why_not_priced: Dated 30 Oct 2026, after the Renta 4 preview (28 Oct), which models FY26 POI falling to EUR36m and says nothing about FY27 POI. Logista's guide excludes POI, so the gain reaches reported numbers and commentary rather than the headline guide. This is macro-to-company transmission the company has not yet confirmed, hence the small size.
findings.independence: Italian press, Sep-Oct 2026, on the 2027 increase of about 25 cents a pack: https://quifinanza.it/osservatorio-prezzi/prezzi-sigarette-2027-aumenti/1017450/ . Logista itself credited 'favourable inventory valuation changes' in Italy for 9M growth: https://www.logista.com/en/home/media/press-releases/20260724.html

findings.finding: The dividend floor of at least EUR2.09 a share covers only through 2026 and the FY25 payout was already 99% of net profit, with FY26 net profit seen flat (-0.4%, Renta 4). The release has to say whether the floor carries into FY27. The interim was raised 3.6% to EUR0.58, so a cut is unlikely, but it would be the large negative on a yield stock.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No observed cut. Each prior reaffirmation (FY24 and FY25 results) came with a positive day: +2.20% and +2.71%.
findings.source_date: 2026-08 (snippet_only: quote taken from the search snippet; article not fetched)
findings.original_quote: El siguiente hito al que conviene prestar atención será la publicación del cierre del ejercicio fiscal 2026 ... cuando el consejo tendrá que decidir si mantiene los 2,09 euros en 2027. (Spanish: the next milestone is the FY2026 close, when the board will have to decide whether it keeps the EUR2.09 in 2027.)
findings.why_not_priced: The stock trades at a yield of about 5.7%, which assumes the floor holds. Renta 4 expects 'al menos 2,09' only for 2026 and says nothing about 2027. Sized as an expectation over a skewed distribution: mostly zero, with a fat left tail.

findings.finding: Reaction base rate from the tape: LOG closed higher on each of its last five dated results days (Nov 6 2024 +2.20%, Nov 6 2025 +2.71%, Feb 5 2026 +4.85%, Apr 30 2026 +1.40%, Jul 24 2026 +2.46%; median +2.46%), including days with negative headline profit.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: This finding is the reaction history itself. On these five days IBEX moved -2.90, +0.12, -1.97, +0.78 and +1.65.
findings.why_not_priced: The sealed history used estimated cadence dates (for example 2025-10-20 instead of the real 2025-11-06) and gives a 1.11% median with mixed signs, so the baseline does not carry this pattern. It is a base rate, not information about this print, so it is sized small.
findings.independence: Results dates confirmed by the issuer's calendar and press releases: https://www.logista.com/en/home/investors-shareholders/financial-calendar.html

findings.finding: Spot (about EUR36.4-36.5) is above every sourced price target: Renta 4 Mantener with TP EUR34.50 (28 Oct 2026) and an aggregator mean of about EUR32.70. The main preview expects no significant price impact, which caps the upside from an in-line print.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The stock has re-rated from 29.6 (Nov 2025) to 36.5 while consensus targets lagged, and that has not stopped positive print days so far.
findings.original_quote: Renta 4 mantiene su recomendación de Mantener con precio objetivo de 34,50 euros por acción ... no espera 'un impacto significativo en la cotización'. (Spanish: Renta 4 keeps Hold with a EUR34.50 target and does not expect a significant impact on the share price.)
findings.why_not_priced: It is partly priced, since targets are public. The new part is that the print is the first chance for brokers to roll targets to FY27, and an in-line guide gives them no reason to chase the price. Small.

baseline_tension: Mild agreement with the +4.18% 20-day run-up; the run-up itself is the lean, since no register was readable. The findings are mostly orthogonal to it (bar arithmetic, excise timing, dividend floor), and the valuation item cuts against it.
language_note: Spanish OIR (Convocatoria, 19 Oct 2026) gave the release timing 'antes de apertura del mercado bursátil'. That settled the session, which the vendor had unresolved; the English calendar page gives only the date.
Spanish broker preview (Renta 4 via Bolsamanía/CapitalBolsa, 28 Oct 2026) is the only sourced bar: FY26 ex-POI EUR349m, net profit EUR279.9m, FY27 +4.4%, TP 34.50. No English preview carried figures.
Spanish press (Estrategias de Inversión) frames the EUR2.09 floor as expiring with FY2026, with the board to decide on 2027. English sources only restate the 2026 commitment.
The Italian-language source (Open, 30 Oct 2026) carried the brought-forward Jan and Jul 2027 excise steps. This is not Spanish, but it is local-language and absent from the English results.
lessons_applied: 'The move is in the guide' (FY27 first guide is a scheduled guidance event): abs_move_pct raised from 3.0 to 3.5. Not raised to the 9% base, because the name is a low-vol defensive (20d vol 17%) whose last two annual-results days moved 2.2-2.7% and the guide is expected to be repeated.
'A finding about a number the market has already been told' and the core table's 'lands inside what the company guided': finding 1 (Q4 run-rate) cut from +0.4 to +0.3.
Bar single-sourced (one broker): p_up moved from 56 to 55; bar-dependent findings were already capped small.
'Let the reaction history move p_up, not abs_move_pct': the five-for-five positive print days are kept as a small finding and in p_up, and are not used to shrink or cap abs_move_pct.
